title: Someone actually played the demo of my game that I released yesterday and completed it!
author: Critical-Truth-3404
selftext:
I am so, so, so happy.

Someone played the demo of my game that I released yesterday and was kind enough to leave some really good feedback.

That makes me so happy that I've decided to continue working on Chapter 2.

I was honestly feeling a bit sad when nobody seemed to find the game for the first few hours. I eventually went to sleep thinking maybe no one would play it. But someone actually did. And not just that, they completed it!

It's such a surreal feeling knowing that someone actually invested their time in playing something that I created. Something that I've spent so much time working on.

One person might not sound like a lot, but this one person has given me more than enough reason to start working on Chapter 2.

For anyone else who would like to give it a try, here's the game:

[https://warlordvii.itch.io/found-by-dusk](https://warlordvii.itch.io/found-by-dusk)

BTW, if anyone is wondering how I know someone completed it, there's a feedback form in the game that players can fill out to share their experience. That's how I found out!

And finally, thank you to the person who played the game and left feedback. If you're reading this, you genuinely made my day. ❤️
